Big day for us: Osmo Studio is officially live, and we're announcing our $5M seed led by Bain Capital Ventures (BCV), with Basis Set, MVP Ventures, Collaborative Fund, Scott Belsky and others. Here's why I joined this team. Four years as a brand manager at Procter & Gamble taught me how ideas actually get made. I'd picture the shot in my head on a Monday, write the brief by Friday, then watch it travel: agency kickoff, three rounds of feedback, and a version 7 that somehow looked less like the idea than version 2. Weeks later, something would come back. Sometimes it was great. Sometimes I'd sit in the review meeting quietly mourning the thing I'd originally imagined. Last week, I had an idea for a launch asset in the morning. By that afternoon, it existed. Not a mockup, not a “directional draft”, the real thing, and it looked like what was in my head. That distance, between imagining something and seeing it real, is exactly what Osmo bridges. This past year at Stanford University Graduate School of Business, I've been surrounded by people building the AI future, and honestly, it's hard not to be inspired by what's possible. But the more I learned, the clearer one thing became: the direction this technology takes isn't inevitable. It's chosen by the people who build it. I wanted to be on a team choosing well. Because AI is already flooding the world with content nobody asked for, and the answer isn't more slop, faster. It's tools that put creative control back in the hands of people with taste and a perspective. That's what Osmo Studio is, and today everyone gets to try it. Grateful to be part of this journey with Chris He, Will Hoppin, Oleksandr Shevenionov, Basil Alfaro and the whole Osmo team. If you make things, or you're the person waiting on briefs like I was, come play. I'd love to hear what you think.

I'm excited to announce Osmo Studio, an ai-native video production suite that bridges the power of codegen with a canvas and timeline. We see quality video production as a product of collaboration rather than one-shot delegation, believing that the human in the loop is not a vestige to be excised but the center of the story. By partnering with in-house filmmakers and motion designers, we are building the most dynamic, expressive, and intuitive toolkit to bring your ideas to life. It has been a joy to think deeply about verifiable vs unverifiable rewards, continually improving agent harnesses, multimodal reasoning, efficiency, and the form factor of software with ai and human consumers in mind. Very grateful to our investors Bain Capital Ventures (BCV), Basis Set, Collaborative Fund, MVP Ventures, Scott Belsky, Sarah Smith, Kevin Patrick Mahaffey, and many others for our $5M seed. I am so continuously inspired by the relentless eye for detail, joy, and craft of our team Oleksandr Shevenionov Basil Alfaro Will Hoppin Chris He Sophie Salvadori-Roam Sam Grozian Pedro Marnoto Pereira Nikolas Welchel Justine Chang. The most personal is truly the most creative! Check us out at osmo.inc
...
Today I'm announcing Osmo! Every company has a storyteller. Someone who can see the whole story in their head. Until now, they've had only two ways to bring it to life: spend years learning video production or hand it off and hope for the best. So we built the third option. Osmo Studio is the first end-to-end, editable video platform. Our product generates animations as editable code rather than fixed AI output, giving storytellers complete authorship over the final result. Our team is full of directors, cinematographers, and editors who spent their careers on real sets including at A24, NBC and Saturday Night Live. We’ve made 50+ films in the last 7 months for Cognition, Parallel Web Systems, Physical Intelligence, Basis, and some of the fastest-growing companies alive, all on the exact tool we're releasing today. Thank you to our earliest believers, who put $5M behind our mission - Hollywood and Silicon Valley under one roof, and tools that empower the next generation of storytellers to express themselves freely. Led by Bain Capital Ventures (BCV), with Basis Set, MVP Ventures, Collaborative Fund, Sarah Smith Fund, Scott Belsky, Kevin Patrick Mahaffey and others. To my cofounders Will Hoppin, Oleksandr Shevenionov, Basil Alfaro, our founding team Huey S., Sam Grozian, Justine Chang, Sophie Salvadori-Roam, Nikolas Welchel, Pedro Marnoto Pereira and customers who bet on us, this is yours as much as mine! Osmo is committed to being a home for the frontier creatives to make their masterpiece. If you're a storyteller who has been boxed in by your tools, Osmo is available now, try it out for free!

You've seen the videos they've made on your feeds for Cog, PI and Parallel Web Systems. I was struck by their level of intensity and passion for filmmaking. It shows in the product. In an era where AI is accelerating timelines, it's never been more important to tell your story. These stories demand new tools: AI that puts creatives in control and is both powerful and easy to use. They built Osmo Studios for themselves: every video they make directly improves the software. Users get pro-grade Pixar quality outputs while working out of a friendly interface. They are the perfect team to unlock the $40bn creative software market with AI. highlights: Today, Osmo, the storytelling studio with a software factory, is making its end-to-end video product generally available to storytellers and GTM teams at high-growth companies. Osmo is also announcing a $5 million seed round led by Bain Capital Ventures, with participation from Basis Set Ventures, MVP Ventures, Collaborative Fund, Scott Belsky, and others.

Huge congrats to Chris He, Oleksandr Shevenionov, Will Hoppin, and Basil Alfaro on launching Osmo Studio today! We at Bain Capital Ventures (BCV) are proud to be leading their $5M seed round, with Basis Set, Collaborative Fund, MVP Ventures, Scott Belsky, Sarah Smith Fund, Kevin Patrick Mahaffey, Melisa Seah and others. Osmo started as a software and film studio. When Christina Melas-Kyriazi and I first met the team, we were struck by the quality of their projects and their passion for filmmaking. They were products builders who had also spent real time on set, and knew firsthand that legacy tools simply weren't built for the new wave of creators who want to tell their stories through video. Over the last 7 months, the team has made over 50 films and commercials for companies like Cognition, Parallel Web Systems, and Physical Intelligence-- using the tool they are launching today. Today, Osmo is an end-to-end editable video platform. Import a Figma file, paste in frontend code, or drop in a reference video. It generates animation as editable code, with full control over the timeline, layers, vectors, motion, and brand rules. Teams at Webflow, Resend, Rho, and Gumloop are already shipping with it. Try it for yourself at osmo.inc! (And, of course, this video was directed by Will Hoppin and made by the Osmo team, in Osmo Studio.)

results.title: Osmo Studio Announces Frontier Editing Software and Film Studio | Basil Alfaro posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.snippet: After a year of non-stop building and filmmaking across New York, LA, London, and SF, today I'm announcing Osmo Studio! I co-founded Osmo because I truly found my people and my purpose. Filmmakers, designers, and computer scientists who’ve come together to create the next-gen storytelling studio. We’re making frontier editing software for fully controllable animation and VFX assets in post-production, combined with a commercial film studio that’s already shipped 50+ real films the past year. Old editing tools force you to master an esoteric workflow before aptly being able to create. New tools promise speed and quality, but typically are a lottery machine of AI slop. Ours hits that balance for speed and control, tested constantly against our increasingly ambitious film projects. To our investors, thanks for believing in us so unrelentingly. We raised a $5 million seed round led by Bain Capital Ventures (BCV), with participation from Basis Set, Collaborative Fund, MVP Ventures, Scott Belsky, Sarah Smith, Kevin Patrick Mahaffey, and many others. results.snippet: Today, we’re launching Osmo Studio to the public! For most of my life, I felt like I had to choose between two obsessions: computer science at Stanford, Columbia, and FT software engineering, then media work at A24, NBC, and Saturday Night Live. I thought becoming world class meant picking one. But, a year ago I tried to combine them and genuinely found my life’s purpose. We started Osmo as a software and film studio. Now, I get to write the architecture we make movies with and make the movies themselves. Each side makes the other better. We built the software through more than 50 real films and commercials, for storytellers who do not have a decade to spend mastering traditional tools. Osmo Studio is an end-to-end editable video platform. Import a Figma file, paste in frontend code, or drop in a reference video. It generates animation as editable code, with control over the timeline, layers, vectors, motion, and brand rules. Teams at Webflow, Resend, Rho, and Gumloop are already shipping with it. snippets.snippet: Today, we’re launching Osmo Studio to the public! For most of my life, I felt like I had to choose between two obsessions: computer science at Stanford, Columbia, and FT software engineering, then media work at A24, NBC, and Saturday Night Live. I thought becoming world class meant picking one. But, a year ago I tried to combine them and genuinely found my life’s purpose. We started Osmo as a software and film studio. Now, I get to write the architecture we make movies with and make the movies themselves. Each side makes the other better. We built the software through more than 50 real films and commercials, for storytellers who do not have a decade to spend mastering traditional tools. Osmo Studio is an end-to-end editable video platform. Import a Figma file, paste in frontend code, or drop in a reference video. It generates animation as editable code, with control over the timeline, layers, vectors, motion, and brand rules. Teams at Webflow, Resend, Rho, and Gumloop are already shipping with it.
